MIST_ECO.DeleteConfirm: Remove {name}? Hold Shift to skip this question.

Project.Title: Project
Project.Name: Name
Project.DaysHint: 0 for a project that just keeps going, such as a workshop in use; it gives its rewards every day.
Project.RepeatHint: After its days the project gives its rewards and starts over instead of being completed.
Project.CostHint: Paid once, when the project starts.
Project.RewardsHint: Given each time the project finishes its days. A reward to a group adds people to it.
Project.UnlocksHint: Locked projects that become available when this one is completed.
Project.Unnamed: ({count} of them not named yet; choose who with the workers button)
Project.CopyHint: Each chosen city gets its own copy that has not started.

Reward.WholeHint: Rolls a whole number from From to To, for things counted one by one.
Reward.ChanceHint: How often the reward comes: 100% always, 50% every other time on average.

Features.Hint: Features work like an adversary's: Daggerheart feature items with a description and their own effects. A region's or country's features reach every city inside.
Features.Title: Feature
Features.Name: Name
Features.SourceHint: A project, an event, a deal…
Features.GrantsHint: When this project is completed (not each cycle of a repeating one), these features are added to its base or to the headquarters. Drag a feature item here to grant a copy of it, effects included; or name a plain one. A base without a headquarters keeps both.
Features.DescriptionHint: What it gives; each line becomes a paragraph
Features.LinkedHint: When the project completes, a copy of this item is added, with its effects.

Effects.Title: Effects
Effects.KeysHint: Use these keys on an effect's Changes tab, on the actor or on a feature, with the Add mode: 3 for +3, -1 for −1.
Effects.Hint: Effects move a city's counters: a plantation raises the Supplies maximum, a riot lowers Order. A region's or country's effects change its bonuses, which reach every city inside.

Keys.max: maximum of a counter (Add 3: three plantations)
Keys.bonusMax: maximum of a counter in every city inside
Keys.bonusValue: value of a counter in every city inside

Days.NextHint: Moves the world time one day forward. Projects work and everyone eats.

Counters.Title: Counters
Counters.Hint: Each counter is a tracker like in Daggerheart: features raise its maximum (three plantations around the city: Supplies max +3), the GM moves its value. Click a box to set it; click the last filled box to clear it.
Counters.BonusHint: Added by effects of the city, its region and its country
Counters.NoMax: No maximum yet: give the city a feature or set its own maximum.

Groups.Title: People
Groups.Name: Group
Groups.GuardHint: Guards keep watch: they count as guards, not residents.
Groups.CanWorkHint: People of this group can be taken for projects.

Bonuses.Title: Bonuses to every city
Bonuses.Hint: A region or country has no counters of its own: it shows the sums of its cities. What is set here, and what its features' effects add, goes to every city inside.

Territory.Name: Name
Territory.DropRegion: Drag a region here to add it to this country.
Territory.DropCity: Drag a city here to add it to this region.
Territory.DetachConfirm: Remove {name} from {parent}? It keeps everything it has.
